message.content: {"id": "i4", "meaning_zh": "固定在客厅墙面上的圆形计时挂钟，兼具报时与墙面装饰作用。", "examples": [{"en": "This round wall clock hanging above the TV console matches the neutral tone of the home space perfectly.", "zh": "挂在电视置物架上方的这个圆形挂钟，和整个家的中性色调特别搭。"}, {"en": "I chose a minimalist round wall clock for my new rental flat in London to add a touch of calm to the living area.", "zh": "我给伦敦的新出租屋选了一款极简圆形挂钟，给客厅增添了一点沉静的氛围。"}], "usage_note_zh": "日常口语里常直接简称为 wall clock，强调造型时再加 round、minimalist 等修饰词即可。"}

parsed_json.meaning_zh: 固定在客厅墙面上的圆形计时挂钟，兼具报时与墙面装饰作用。

examples.en: This round wall clock hanging above the TV console matches the neutral tone of the home space perfectly.
